TEMPTATION ||| Lean closer, letting his warmth seep into me. ||| "What if I just told everyone the truth?"  
BOUNDARY ||| Step back, keeping the Answer steady in my grip. ||| "I won't say anything until I know what happened."  
CONFESSION ||| Meet his gaze, vulnerability spilling out. ||| "I feel lost without your guidance in this."  
REVERSAL ||| Take a breath and seize the moment. ||| "I will find out what you know, and you will help me."  
SILENCE ||| Hold the Answer tightly, my heart racing. ||| *A silent breath, a moment suspended.*
